title: The mind, body and spirit tarot spread
description: How the three-card mind, body and spirit tarot spread works: what each position means, how to lay it out, and how to use it as a gentle regular check-in.

scenes.headline: The mind, body and spirit tarot spread
scenes.caption: The mind, body and spirit tarot spread is a three-card check-in on your thoughts, your daily energy and your sense of meaning. It is for reflection, not health advice.
scenes.vo: The mind, body and spirit tarot spread is a three-card check-in on your thoughts, your daily energy and your sense of meaning. It is for reflection, not health advice.

scenes.headline: The three positions
scenes.caption: Mind, body, then spirit.
scenes.vo: The three positions. Mind, body, then spirit.

scenes.headline: How to lay it out
scenes.caption: Arrange the cards in a triangle. Place card 1, Mind, at the lower left and card 2, Body, at the lower right.
scenes.vo: How to lay it out. Arrange the cards in a triangle. Place card 1, Mind, at the lower left and card 2, Body, at the lower right.

scenes.headline: Have a tarot spread in front of you?
scenes.caption: Photograph it and get a clear reading, card by card.
scenes.vo: Have a tarot spread in front of you? Photograph it at read my spread dot com, and get a clear reading, card by card.
